title: RuneScape Dragonwilds - Scorched Ruins (SOLO) SPEEDRUN Attempt #3 (26:12)
author: Mattie Beasinger
description: Cut a couple minutes off, honestly not sure what happened with that "Green Dragon" midway through. There aren't any green drags here as far as I know so not even going to try to figure that one out lol. Anyway, one thing I have seen online is people using skips to both defeat Kuldra AND unlock all of the checkpoints way way faster. I personally am trying to see how fast it can be done without any skips so I will be avoiding using any of those for my videos in this series. However, if there is anyone wanting to see runs with those skips involved I will definitely upload a few videos on those too! There are some serious time savers that can get an entire scorched ruins run down to less than 7 minutes, BUT they are very cheezy and definitely aren't intentionally coded to work that way.
